candidateDispositions.note: English “Qin” in “southern Qin” renders 南秦, a regional/polity locator in 釗自南秦與漢嘉太守王載共距之, not a personal name.
English “Mount Tai” renders the place component of 海岱間 (between the sea and Mount Tai), not a person.
